summary: Frontend-only testing for static URL across 3-step registration + universal /exhibition/thank-you page. All 7 acceptance criteria verified end-to-end via Playwright on the public preview URL.
critical_code_review_comments: Console warning: 'In HTML, <span> cannot be a child of <option>' originates from the Emergent dev-tooling wrapper (x-ve-dynamic span injected into <option> in RegistrationModal Step 3). Cosmetic dev-only warning, no functional impact in production builds.

ThankYouPage falls back gracefully on direct visit (no sessionStorage), but it still renders the dark exhibition pass card with '—' placeholders because `data` is null and `isNotify` is false. Consider rendering a friendlier 'No active registration found, return home' state when sessionStorage is empty — not blocking, just polish.

RegistrationModal.submit() persists to sessionStorage AFTER the await axios.post; if the network call fails the user sees an alert and stays on the form (good), but the sessionStorage write is inside the try block AFTER the axios call — confirmed correct ordering.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified flows on https://sacred-rudraksha-hub.preview.emergentagent.com: (1) /exhibition/chennai/register URL stays IDENTICAL through Step 1 → Step 2 → Step 3 (no /contact, no /details suffix). (2) Submit on Step 3 navigates to exactly /exhibition/thank-you (universal, no slug). (3) Thank-You page renders gold ✓, 'Registration Confirmed!', 'Namaste 🙏', dark luxury YOUR EXHIBITION PASS card with Exhibition='Rudralife · Chennai', Visit Date='15 May 2026', Timings='10:00 am to 8:00 pm (Sunday Open)', Full Schedule='15th to 17th May 2026', Venue='The Park Chennai', Address with Open in Maps link, 'Team Rudralife' regards. (4) WhatsApp CTA href = https://wa.me/917208819922?text=Namaste%20%F0%9F%99%8F%20I%20have%20registered%20for%20Chennai%20on%2015%20May%202026.%20My%20name%20is%20Anjali%20Mehta. — name + exhibition + date all encoded correctly. (5) Coming Soon flow /exhibition/hyderabad/coming-soon → NotifyModal → submit → /exhibition/thank-you with 'We Have Your Interest!' headline, NO pass card (confirmed in notify_fail.png screenshot). (6) Direct visit to /exhibition/thank-you renders without crashing. (7) Landing → click Chennai card → navigates to /exhibition/chennai standalone page (not inline modal). Note: my notify_flow assertion logged a stale title because it read .rl-thanks-title before React re-rendered after navigate(); the screenshot proves the correct 'We Have Your Interest!' was rendered.
verified_acceptance_criteria: URL static across all 3 registration steps — PASS
Thank-You page luxury pass card with all 6 details + WhatsApp CTA + Close — PASS
WhatsApp href starts with wa.me/917208819922 and prefilled text includes name+exhibition — PASS
Coming Soon flow → /exhibition/thank-you with notify branch (no pass card) — PASS (visual confirmed)
Direct visit to /exhibition/thank-you renders gracefully — PASS
Landing → live city → /exhibition/:slug standalone (not inline) — PASS
